title: FREE REQUEST Seeking Team Members for Gilded Cage Project.

posts.author: Yuyunneri
posts.body:
Hello everyone!
We are currently recruiting people for the Gilded Cage Project, an upcoming indie adventure and suspense game being developed with RPG Maker XP. The game blends elements of visual novels to create a captivating and immersive experience.
Genre:
Adventure, Horror, Suspense
Engine
: RPG Maker XP
Synopsis:
The Gilded Cage Project is set in a surreal and deadly world where you take on the role of Sevastian, one of five boys who suddenly find themselves trapped in a life-or-death game. To escape this nightmare, they must confront unimaginable dangers and make choices that could mean the difference between life and death. The first chapter takes place in a cemetery filled with stuffed animals, where anything can lead to a brutal demise.
Positions/Roles Needed:
- Sprite Artist
- Pixel Art Artist
- Pixel Art Assets Artist
- Plugin Programmer
- GUI Designer
- Programmer
- Editor
- Composer
If you're interested, we would love to have more people join the team. Please feel free to check out
here
for details, and if you’d like to be part of the project, don’t hesitate to send us an email with your portfolio and information about your work!
My Role(s)/Position(s):
I am a designer, writer, and programmer.
Skill Trade:
Designer, writer, programmer, and beta tester.
